summary:
This project addresses the NASA Space Apps Challenge "Identify Earth Locations that Analog the Permanent Moon Base Locations and Mars." I identified places on earth where machines and systems for lunar and martian bases can be tested before launch.
For each Moon and Mars target site, I studied terrain, craters and surface conditions, then matched with the most similar earth location.Each site is documented with the place name, photos and the reasons for the mach.
To present these comparisons,I built an interactive web tool.It places Earth and Moon or Mars imagery side by side with a "Curtain" slider and a "Toggle" mode, plus notes under each comparison explaining reasons.
This approach supports safer. lower-cost testing of space technology here on Earth.
details: My project uses an interactive web tool to compare two possible analog places on Earth.For the reasons i studied geomorphological and geological factors.I uploaded an PDF of my website.
